name: @pipeworx/mcp-color

tools.name: color_convert
tools.description: Convert a color (HEX, rgb(), hsl(), or a CSS name) to all formats: HEX, RGB and HSL. Keyless, offline.

tools.name: color_contrast
tools.description: Compute the WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio between two colors and whether it passes AA/AAA for normal and large text. Keyless, offline.

tools.name: nearest_color
tools.description: Find the nearest CSS named color to a given color (Euclidean RGB distance). Keyless, offline.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-color forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the color pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
